facts.fact: Uganda's Ministry of ICT says it signed a memorandum of understanding on 11 May 2026 with the DRC Ministry of Posts, Telecommunications and Digital Economy, including a project to connect Uganda's National Backbone Infrastructure to the DRC's fibre-optic network.
facts.system: Uganda National Backbone to DRC fibre interconnection
